title_en: SUPER DEAL!!! Apartment for sale 3+1+2 and yard in Farke-kleringu
description_en: OPPORTUNITY APARTMENT 3+1+2 WITH PRIVATE COURTYARD IN FARKE E VOGEL In the quiet and sought-after area of Farkë e Vogël, a modern apartment suitable for both residence and investment is offered for sale. The apartment has a net area of 106.6 m², a gross area of 127.54 m² and a private yard of 96.5 m². It is organized in a living room with a shared kitchen, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a storage room. the completion of construction is expected in July 2026. The price of the apartment is 1500 euros per m², while the yard is 300 euros per m². The apartment has a parking space with an extra price of 20,000 euros. For more information or to visit, contact us
